system_boundary.description: Synthetic known-truth biological reference whose activity occurs in short bursts between sparse observations.

expected_result.reason: Sparse sampling is much slower than the target process timescale. A non-detection in sampled frames is an observation about the sampled windows, not evidence of absence during the full interval.

source.note: The full synthetic generator contains short-lived events between acquired samples; this public fixture freezes the sampling envelope.

limitations: The fixture tests temporal aliasing only; spatial gaps are covered by a separate Sol-Atlas benchmark.
The temporal coverage fraction is a synthetic ground-truth property, not an instrument performance result.
No life-presence posterior may be updated from the non-detection.
